integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducible finite comparisons are supplied. Independent validation has not been performed; finite computations are not presented as exhaustive over all lengths.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct directed cyclic adjacent-pair profiles for a labeled ternary alphabet, including periodic circular words; no noisy-channel correction, general alphabets or longer reads. Possible equivalent formula in unindexed enumerative literature.
title: Circular ternary directed-pair spectra: an exact rational count and connectivity deficit
